title: Equivalent fractions, grade 4

beats.label: Settle and show the strip
key_points: students explain why 1/2 = 2/4 = 3/6 using fraction strips.
Settle and show the strip for 1/2.

beats.label: Pairs fold strips
key_points: Pairs fold strips to find another fraction equal to 1/2.
They must write the pair, like 1/2 and 2/4.

beats.label: Gallery
key_points: Record only what they say on the board.
If time is short, cut the gallery to two shares.

beats.label: Exit ticket
key_points: Write two fractions equal to 1/2 and say how you know.

beats.label: Collect tickets
key_points: Do not give the answer key.
already presented yesterday, so invite someone else.
beats.whisper_cue: Do not give the answer key.

key_phrases: Write two fractions equal to 1/2 and say how you know.
do_not: Don't call on the same three students.
Do not give the answer key.
notes: Materials: paper strips, one marker, exit slip half-sheet.
